title: Getting Started with Prisma and PostgreSQL
content:
# Getting Started with Prisma and PostgreSQL

Prisma makes database access type-safe and developer-friendly, and with PostgreSQL you get production-grade reliability.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @prisma/client @prisma/adapter-pg pg
npm install -D prisma @types/pg
```

## Schema Definition

```prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id    String @id @default(cuid())
  email String @unique
  name  String?
}
```

Prisma with PostgreSQL is perfect for production applications, portfolios, and projects that need reliability and performance.
